title: Realism: Overhated
description: an (un)fun minecraft that orients towards "realism" while straying a bit away at the same time.
body:
**WARNING: this mod was posted early since i wanted to show it to my friends.

 this product's quality is currently bad.
~~theres not much to add for now.~~

a realism modpack focused on acting like a realism modpack, but not everything being about real life.

# what this modpack brings?
this modpack has a strong leaning towards Tinker's Construct and Create, it is _**Strongly**_ recommended to understand how these mods works first. _(or use TconJEI, Create's Ponder or even Tinker's Construct/Create wiki)_
additionally, other notable mods would be Sophis backpacks, Petite Inventory, First Aid, Paraglider, Parcool, dyeable redstone, hardcore revival co-op, TaCZ, Alternative Earlygame _(affects furnace recipe)_, Chalk, Dye Depot _(adds more dye colors)_, and other mods i thought would possibly fit.

# How is it played?
1. _**(Normally, this mod was made with Hardcore in mind, but i suggest a regular world to learn a bit of the mod yourself.)**_
1. with mods like First Aid, it becomes considerably harder to go just tanking ever.
1. additionally, this mod also contains mods that makes early game stage last longer, since now you cant just punch trees and get wood; you'll now need a **axe** to do that, and a **saw** to cut it into planks.
1. after crafting your first **pickaxe**, mine some iron ores, then use a **Crushing Hammer** to crush them to pieces, later smelt them on a campfire to get **nuggets**, which can be combined with clay to craft **reinforced clay**; then **reinforced bricks**, then finally, the furnace.
1. from the spoken warning early, most of your proggresion is tinkers: but you should also explore and craft other items that will help you, like **Spirit Orbs** that can be used to increase max hp and stamina that is used to do parkour, for example.
1. additionally, with the Thirst mechanic and well, water states, you must clean up the water by boiling it in a campfire or furnace, to avoid obtaining sickness while hydrating.
1. craft a **backpack**, upgrade it so it can include more automation (not for more item slots, sadly.) and a **tool belt** that helps with carrying your unstackable items.
> _achivements also help a bit early game orientation, but i left a guide... above, oops._
